thresholds.impact: Maximum OASDI tax is $11,439.00 each for employer and employee.
No limit on covered wages; matched 50/50 by employer.
0.9% employee withholding on excess; no employer match.
Effective rate 0.6% ($42 max per employee) with timely SUTA credit.
Pre-tax retirement withholding limit adjusted for inflation.
Exempt from federal income tax and FICA when pre-tax.
